title: Case: The same closure complaint arrives again by email after it was answered and logged
context: A recipient complained on the portal about a parcel held by the motorcade closures. The desk replied, logged a formal complaint and told him the reference. An identical email then arrives; its footer shows it was written before the portal message and held in his outbox.
initial_request:
Third time this year Quillmoor Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-8464, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.

-- 
This message was held in your Outbox and sent when a connection became available. Originally written 13:39.

events.body: Network notice NN-2353. State visit to Calderbridge, 14 and 12 October. Police will run rolling road closures in central Calderbridge (zones C1 to C3) between 09:00 and 15:00 UTC on both days. A segment closes about 20 minutes before the motorcade and reopens once it has passed. Police set the timings and do not share them with carriers in advance. Vans are held at Wexley Road depot or at a staging point while their segment is closed. Held consignments are delivered once routes reopen where possible; anything not delivered by 18:00 rolls to the next working day automatically. We will not give individual ETAs while closures are active. Please do not open trace requests for held consignments.

Third time this year Quillmoor Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-8464, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.
Formal complaint from Delphine Quarrie about DL-8464, held today by the state visit road closures. He says this is the third disappointing delivery this year. Please log it and reply to him directly.

Hi Delphine, I'm sorry about the boots. DL-8464 is held on a van by today's police road closures for the state visit. Quillmoor Arc can't give arrival times while the roads are closed; if it can't reach you by 18:00 it moves to the next working day automatically. I've passed your formal complaint to Quillmoor Arc's Customer relations team and they'll reply to you directly.
Complaint logged for Delphine Quarrie, DL-8464, reference CR-4416. We will respond to him directly within 5 working days.
Your complaint is logged with Quillmoor Arc's Customer relations team as CR-4416. They will reply to you directly within 5 working days.

Third time this year Quillmoor Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-8464, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.

-- 
This message was held in your Outbox and sent when a connection became available. Originally written 13:39.

must: Takes no action and sends no message
Records that the email is a delayed copy of the 13:40 portal complaint (same text, written 13:39, held in his outbox), already answered with CR-4416
must_not: Raises a second complaint with Customer relations or asks them to escalate CR-4416
Replies to Delphine again, by email or portal, restating the status or the complaint reference
Gives an arrival time for DL-8464 or opens a trace for it
Offers compensation or a goodwill gesture

rationale: Rule-made from city-010: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
